scope: EVT contact face-seal trial; not a qualified wet barrier or released contact material/finish

seal_candidate.material: NBR70; exact compound/cure system and compatibility require confirmation
seal_candidate.limits: Incoming dimensions are proposed trial acceptance limits, not a manufacturer tolerance agreement. Coupon-test the actual ring, plastic and casting system for inhibition, swelling and leaks; do not assume NBR compatibility with platinum-cure silicone or finished body-contact suitability.

gland.location: Annular axial recess in the METAL post bearing face; plastic remains a flat sealing counterface
gland.note: Maintain the4mm post head, face coordinates, silicone-key groove, M2 thread and dock stop datums. Both machined faces must seat on the rigid bearing land; nut torque must not be used to set an arbitrary gasket compression. Printed rough faces are fit coupons only. Agree tool access and finish with the machinist before ordering.

CAD_seal.scope: Volume-preserving elliptical section representing the nominal installed space, not an FEA or contact-pressure prediction

process.assembly: Solder the post tail with no O-ring fitted. Clean flux, inspect plating/face and let it cool; fit the ring without dragging it over a sharp thread, then fixture the face and retain with the M2 nut on the removed rear half. Actual torque/locking and strain relief remain to qualify.
process.molding: Keep the seal gland excluded from the external silicone cavity. The outer silicone groove captures the post; the inner face seal is a separate candidate barrier. Leak-test an inert closed cavity and run cure-inhibition coupons before any battery/electronics casting.
process.acceptance: Inspect all four bearing seats, face coplanarity and electrical isolation. Demonstrate no dye entry through individual contacts, seam, buttons or root under the defined wet/cleaning/thermal profile. Ring/finish/preload/material aging and post pullout require physical validation.
process.open: No finished contact stock/plating, nut locking/torque, permanent button barrier, full cavity seal or casting recipe is released. This face-seal trial alone does not make the product waterproof.

reference_limit: Parker general static face-seal principles inform squeeze/fill checks; its larger standard gland tables do not approve this miniature custom gland.
